trust_decision.summary: ipmgmtd's door dispatcher decides whether a caller may run a modifying (idi_set) command: root, or a user holding solaris.network.interface.config. The caller's ucred is freed early, then freed again on the shared fail label when that check rejects the caller.

landing_point.why: The summary names ipmgmtd and credentials. The only door_ucred/ucred_free pair in the daemon is in ipmgmt_handler, and the advisory text points straight at it.

fix_sites.entry_point: ipmgmtd door (created at usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd/ipmgmt_main.c:211), reached by any idi_set door command from libipadm ipadm_door_call (usr/src/lib/libipadm/common/libipadm.c:902-947), e.g. ipadm set-prop/create-addr run by a non-root user
same function, ipmgmt_handler; the free moves after the authorization checks

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No other ucred handling in ipmgmtd (grep door_ucred|ucred_free under usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd: only usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd/ipmgmt_door.c:108,132,138,170).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No other site to dismiss. The one shared dispatcher covers all 12 set-type commands in the table (usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd/ipmgmt_door.c:74-92).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Root, and non-root users with the solaris.network.interface.config auth, must still reach set handlers. Get commands (idi_set false) skip the credential check entirely. A fix that drops the free leaks the ucred on every call, and one that rejects early breaks authorized users.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dlmgmtd's dispatcher could free cred early (after ucred_getzoneid) and again at done:
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It has the same door_ucred, then a shared cleanup label, in a sister network-config daemon. A maintainer who stopped needing cred after getting the zoneid could plausibly free it early. Today it is correct: freed only at done: behind a NULL check.

O9_family: memory safety: double free (CWE-415) on an error path in a privileged daemon

O10_build.toolchain: illumos nightly build (onbld, gcc/sun-studio shadow, illumos-native build env); builds only on illumos
O10_build.project_tests: None found for ipmgmtd in the pinned tree (not exhaustively searched).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set cred = NULL after the early ucred_free at line 138 (equivalent and correct), or delete the free at fail: (which leaks on the door_ucred-success paths); either way it is one line.

out_of_scope_notes: ipmgmt_handler reads ((ipmgmt_arg_t *)argp)->ia_cmd without checking argsz or argp != NULL (usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd/ipmgmt_door.c:110-112), unlike dlmgmtd, which checks argsz (usr/src/cmd/dlmgmtd/dlmgmt_door.c:1430). This is a separate input-validation weakness, not pursued.
unverified: O10 offline_after_build: the affected code needs a running illumos kernel with doors and SMF; it cannot be exercised in a normal Linux container.
Whether ipmgmtd has any project tests (usr/src/test) was not exhaustively searched.
